4 stars because. It helps with skin but every time you push a button it makes you watch an ad

NICE APP. The skincare analysis is accurate! It can really identify my skin problems and recommend me with the right products, I know it because I’m using some of the products and they actually did work for me! I also love the dos-and-donts part in the analysis, it tells me not to do sth that can really hurt my skin. Overall it’s an interesting app, I’ll use it for a couple of weeks to see if it really can help me improve my skin condition.

Do not like. First off I got on the app and it asked to pay. I don’t think that we should pay for stuff about are health. I got the app because I wanted to know if my skincare is good for me. I started scanning the cosmetics and everything that would come up would be the wrong thing, so I tried a different bottle and it still didn’t come up.

Disappointment. I’m severely disappointed in this app, because to get your face scanned, you must buy extra things in the app. This should be free, and it is supposed to benefit us in our health, and it shouldn’t make us pay for good health.

A Skincare Must-Have!. This app is truly a blessing for skincare enthusiasts! The AI skin analysis is highly professional just take a photo, and it highlights areas for improvement. The recommended skincare routines are practical, and I can adjust my products accordingly. I especially love the detailed analysis reports, which are clear and intuitive, helping me understand my skin issues and improvement directions. Overall, SkinJoy is highly recommended!
